subject: Random Forest
object: representation formed by concatenating three vectors
source_sentence: IMS applies a random forest regression model to a representation formed by concatenating three vectors: 1. a feature vector drawn from existing affect lexicons, 2. a feature vector drawn from expanded affect lexicons, and 3. the output of a neural network.
title: WASSA-2017 Shared Task on Emotion Intensity

subject: Lexicons
source_sentence: The first vector is obtained using the lexicons implemented in the AffectiveTweets package.
title: WASSA-2017 Shared Task on Emotion Intensity

subject: Lexicons
source_sentence: The second is based on an extended lexicons built from feed-forward neural networks trained on word embeddings.
title: WASSA-2017 Shared Task on Emotion Intensity

subject: Neural Network
source_sentence: The third vector is taken from the output of neural network that combines CNN and LSTM layers.
title: WASSA-2017 Shared Task on Emotion Intensity

subject: Regression Model
object: representation formed by the affect lexicon features
source_sentence: Each regression model is trained on a representation formed by the affect lexicon features (including those provided by AffectiveTweets) and word embeddings.
title: WASSA-2017 Shared Task on Emotion Intensity
